target.title: improve(web-fetch): speed up provider fallback loading
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Resolves a performance problem where `web_fetch` shell-like HTML fallback paths repeatedly rediscovered provider fallback state after direct readability extraction returned no content.

## Why This Change Was Made

This adds a deterministic `perf:web-fetch` benchmark and moves provider fallback resolution onto a bounded provider-discovery cache keyed by config object, config fingerprint, and active plugin registry/mode. Transient empty provider snapshots stay uncached, config mutation and registry swaps invalidate the cache, and superseded cache entries are evicted instead of retained indefinitely.

The branch also trims small hot-path work in Firecrawl payload wrapping, web-readability HTML depth checks, and HTML-to-markdown extraction.

## User Impact

Users should see faster lightweight web fetches on pages that do not produce readable article content, while provider fallback behavior still updates when plugins load, unload, config changes, or credentials appear. Developers also get a repeatable offline benchmark for direct text, markdown, article HTML, shell HTML, and extraction-only paths.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/web-fetch/runtime.test.ts src/agents/tools/web-tools.fetch.test.ts src/agents/tools/web-fetch.provider-fallback.test.ts extensions/firecrawl/src/firecrawl-client.test.ts extensions/web-readability/web-content-extractor.test.ts src/agents/tools/web-fetch-utils.test.ts src/agents/tools/web-tools.readability.test.ts` passed: 5 Vitest shards, 110 tests.
- `node --import tsx scripts/bench-web-fetch.ts --runs 50 --warmup 10 --output .artifacts/web-fetch-bench/deep-after-cache-fix.json` passed. Final 50-run comparison against the post-rebase deep baseline: `tool-html-article` avg `4.393ms -> 3.903ms`, `tool-html-shell` avg `0.511ms -> 0.463ms`, `extract-readable-article-text` avg `2.546ms`.
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode branch --base origin/main` clean: no accepted/actionable findings reported after fixing the provider-cache config mutation and cache-retention findings.
- `node scripts/crabbox-wrapper.mjs run --provider blacksmith-testbox --blacksmith-org openclaw --blacksmith-workflow .github/workflows/ci-check-testbox.yml --blacksmith-job check --blacksmith-ref main --idle-timeout 90m --ttl 240m --timing-json -- env OPENCLAW_CHECK_CHANGED_REMOTE_CHILD=1 OPENCLAW_CHANGED_LANES_RAW_SYNC=1 corepack pnpm check:changed` passed on Testbox-through-Crabbox: provider `blacksmith-testbox`, id `tbx_01kwgnqcf3w7m94x66gesmgbtm`, Actions run `28568317305`, exit `0`, total `10m57s`.
